content: These references include studies, reports, guidelines, and tools published by organizations such as the World Health Organization (WHO), UNICEF, and other international bodies. They cover a wide range of subjects, including adolescent health services, school health programs, youth engagement, digital technology use, reproductive health, mental health, and sustainable development. Many of these resources are accessible online and provide evidence-based insights, frameworks, and recommendations for improving health and well-being across different populations and settings.
